summary: Frontend-only retest of the live-editor photo resize persistence fix. The served bundle was fresh: it contains 'body:not(.live-editing) #public-site'. I shrank 8 images (/ cards.0, both Rakhigarhi hero photos, craft hero + craft image, workshops image + collage.1, about items.0) with live-resize-se at 1366x768, 1280x800 and 1920x1080. 22 of 22 runs PASS. Each image box and its img size matched exactly (0px difference) across the editor after Save, after Close editor, after reload while logged in, and on the public page while logged out. None got bigger. Crop/zoom (zoom 1.6 plus pan) persisted on the Rakhigarhi hero: transform matrix(1.6), object-position 29.5% 42.3% was the same in the editor and on the public page. Workshops collage.1 at 1100px matched editor vs public, both for saved sizes (186x248) and after a new shrink (106x168). At 820 and 390 the saved images are fluid and there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals viewport width on all 5 pages). NEW BUG: shrinking the Theatre hero photo (figure.theatre-split-art) does not change its size, which is by design. But the save still writes width/height, and Blocks.jsx layoutStyle then adds an inline 'position: relative !important'. That overrides the stylesheet's position:absolute. The hero photo drops below the text column and gets clipped by .theatre-split overflow:hidden, so only an ~80px strip shows. This happens in the editor and on the public page, at 1366 and at 1920. Content was restored afterwards; diff is clean and the Theatre page looks normal again.

ui_bugs.component: Theatre hero split image (Blocks.jsx layoutStyle line ~48)
ui_bugs.issue: After any resize or move of figure.theatre-split-art, the saved width/height makes layoutStyle set an inline 'position: relative !important' (plus align/justify-self). An inline !important beats the CSS rule '#theatre-reference figure.theatre-split-art { position: absolute !important }'. The photo leaves the right half of the hero, stacks below the copy at top=538 and is clipped by overflow:hidden. The hero photo effectively disappears. This also happens on the public site.

action_items: Fix the Theatre hero: in Blocks.jsx layoutStyle/sx, do not force position:relative (or align-self/justify-self) on elements whose stylesheet position is absolute/fixed. One way: check getComputedStyle in the ref before applying. Another: skip saving geometry for pinned fields like theatre-split-art, or hide the resize handles for them in LiveEditor. Then check that resize + Save + Close on /our-work/theatre leaves the photo on the right half of the hero.
critical_code_review_comments: Blocks.jsx:48 applies position:relative !important inline whenever width/height/translate is saved. This silently breaks any absolutely positioned editable element. The Theatre split art is one current instance.
Rakhigarhi image2 gets --ed-w/--ed-h but no --ed-ar, and has overflow:visible. It still matched in the editor and on the public page; just an inconsistency.

On cards.0.image (home) and the craft hero, the img is 13-20px taller than the saved box (for example box 304x247, img 304x260). This is the same in the editor and on the public page, but the 'photo fills its saved box' rule does not quite hold for figures with --ratio/crop.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (24/25 checks; Theatre hero layout broken after resize)

seed_data_creation: None. Content was backed up before testing and restored after each viewport. The final diff is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Python playwright is not installed locally, so use the browser_automation tool. To pick images, use Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main [data-edit]')).filter(figure/img) by index: / idx1=cards.0.image; rakhigarhi idx0=image, idx1=image2; craft idx0 hero, idx1; workshops idx0, idx3=collage.1; about idx0. The floating editor panel covers the top-right of the viewport. Scroll the image so its bottom sits near innerHeight-120, click a point where elementFromPoint is inside the figure, then drag [data-testid=live-resize-se] by (-80,-80). Then Esc, live-save-btn, wait for live-status 'Everything is saved', live-exit-btn. Zoom: fill [data-testid=live-crop-zoom]; pan: drag [data-testid=live-crop-pan]. Run backup_restore_content.py backup/restore/diff around tests.
rca of the issue: Theatre: Blocks.jsx layoutStyle sets o.position='relative' whenever raw.width/height exist, and applyProps writes it inline with 'important'. Inline !important beats the stylesheet !important from boxed-layout.css:276 (position:absolute). The figure goes back into normal flow below .theatre-split-copy, and .theatre-split{overflow:hidden; height=hero} clips it. Repro: login, open /our-work/theatre?edit=1 at 1366x768, select the hero photo, drag live-resize-se, Save. The photo collapses to a strip under the text. Removing the inline style in DevTools restores the right-side photo.
